# EXAMPLE CORP ANNUAL REPORT ON FORM 10-K

For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024. Commission file number 001-00000. Example Corp is a
Washington corporation whose principal executive offices are located in Redmond, Washington.

## PART I

## Item 1. Business

Example Corp develops and supports software, services, devices and solutions that deliver value
for customers and help people and businesses realize their full potential. Our products include
operating systems, cross-device productivity and collaboration applications, server applications,
business solution applications, desktop and server management tools and software development tools.

We also design and sell devices, including personal computers, tablets, gaming and entertainment
consoles and related accessories. Our cloud platform offers computing, storage, networking and
analytics services to developers and enterprises in more than sixty regions around the world.

Competition in each of our markets is intense. We compete with large and small companies on the
breadth of our offerings, on price and on the trust our customers place in our security practices.

## Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including
those described below, that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of
operations, cash flows and the trading price of our common stock.

We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to
lower revenue or operating margins. Competing in the cloud requires large investments in datacenter
capacity, and these investments may not produce the returns we expect if demand does not grow.

Cyberattacks and security vulnerabilities could lead to reduced revenue, increased costs,
liability claims, or harm to our reputation or competitive position across every segment.

## Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

We have received no written comments regarding our periodic or current reports from the staff of
the Securities and Exchange Commission that remain unresolved at the end of the fiscal year.

## Item 2. Properties

Our corporate headquarters are located in Redmond, Washington, on a campus of owned buildings. We
also own and lease datacenters, offices, research and development facilities and warehouses.

## Item 3. Legal Proceedings

Refer to Note 15 of the Notes to Financial Statements for information regarding legal proceedings
in which we are involved, including antitrust, patent and other matters pending in several courts.

## Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures

Not applicable to our business, which does not operate any mine or quarry in the United States.

## PART II

## Item 5. Market for Registrant's Common Equity

Our common stock is traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the symbol EXMP. On July 25, 2024,
there were approximately eighty thousand registered holders of record of our common stock.

## Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue increased sixteen percent driven by growth across each of our segments, with the cloud
platform growing twenty nine percent year over year as customers moved more workloads to it.

Capital expenditures, including finance leases, were forty four billion dollars, up fifty five
percent, as we invested in datacenter capacity to meet growing demand for cloud and artificial
intelligence infrastructure. Purchases of property and equipment were the largest use of cash.

We fund our investments with cash from operations, which rose to one hundred eighteen billion
dollars, and with our holdings of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments, which
totaled seventy five billion dollars at the end of the fiscal year after the acquisition.

Long-term debt, including the current portion, was forty four billion dollars. We repaid
maturing notes during the year and issued no new long-term debt in the capital markets.

We returned cash to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases, which totaled
thirty four billion dollars, under the repurchase program approved by the Board of Directors.

Operating expenses increased twelve percent, driven by investments in research and development
for artificial intelligence and by the costs of the gaming acquisition completed in October.

## Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

We are exposed to economic risk from foreign exchange rates, interest rates, credit risk and
equity prices. We use derivative instruments to manage these risks, but not for speculation.
